title: Cape Cod Explorer Tour
includes: Use of kayaks and safety equipment
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: RideAway Adventures has been awarded the best tours on Cape Cod 12 years in a row. We have the only fully ACA certified guide staff on Cape Cod. Our tours are small and intimate so that it is a fun and unique experience for every participant. Our equipment is always top of the line and this area is perfect for all levels of kayakers. RideAway Adventures is the highest rated outdoor company on Cape Cod and we are committed to creating ocean ambassadors through education and active environmental awareness.
